page_note: Page is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate: a systematic teaching on the three summonses (ⲁⲓⲍⲙⲉ) describing how Life ascends and Error descends through the cosmic architecture — powers of heaven, bodies/corpses on earth, the five worlds of flesh, firmaments, the wheel of stars. The voice is impersonal-structural and enumerative ("the first summons... the second summons... the third summons"). Only one segment (33) contains an apostolic dialogue frame ("Said the Apostle"), and even there the content addresses the cosmological wheel-of-stars structure. High damage ratio (33%) but where text survives, it is teaching substrate.
